description: Enhance the existing 'Get Started' CTA section with a Filipino-inspired inline SVG background, and add two new landing sections — 'For Performers' and 'For Coaches' — between the existing Features section and the CTA. All changes are additive; zero existing code is removed or restructured.
steps: Step 1 — Add Filipino-inspired decorative SVG pattern to the CTA section in app/page.tsx. The existing CTA section is the last g-section-alt before <PublicLayoutFooterExtra />. Wrap its inner content with a relative container and add an aria-hidden absolute SVG layer inside the existing .g-card that already wraps the CTA. The SVG should contain: (a) radial burst of 16 thin rays from the center (Philippine sun motif) in #FCD116 at ~4% opacity, (b) 3 five-pointed stars scattered in the upper area in #FCD116 at ~5% opacity, (c) a subtle wave / chevron band at the bottom in #0038A8 at ~6% opacity. The existing amber glow div stays. Keep the SVG pointer-events-none aria-hidden. Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) note in the SVG — no transitions are added, so this is satisfied by construction. No CSS additions needed — purely additive SVG markup inside the section.

Step 2 — Create a new 'For Performers' section component as a named function PerformersSection inside app/page.tsx (since the file is already 'use client'). Insert it BEFORE the existing CTA section (search for the comment '══ CTA ══'). The section uses id='performers', g-section class, g-container, <SectionHeader>, and <Reveal className='g-reveal-stagger'>. Include a grid of feature cards using the .g-card .g-card-hover pattern already used by the FEATURES section. Only advertise CONFIRMED client features found in app/(client)/client/home/page.tsx and the QuickActions there: (a) Browse Coaches — discover verified coaches by discipline and rate (/client/talent); (b) Book Appointments — request and track rehearsal sessions (/client/appointments); (c) Manage Calendar — organize your rehearsal schedule (/client/calendar); (d) AI Chat Assistant (Groovey) — get instant help from Groovey AI 24/7 (/client/groovey); (e) Messages — message coaches directly (/messages); (f) Studio Locator — find rehearsal spaces near SJDM (scroll to #studios). CTA button: 'Join as Performer' → opens the existing roleModalOpen via a prop passed down, or links to /register/client. Use the same icon pattern (import from lucide-react) already used in FEATURES: Bot, Calendar, CalendarDays, MessageSquare, MapPin, Sparkles. Grid: 2 cols on sm, 3 on lg. Section is g-section (white band for contrast alternation with CTA which is g-section-alt). Add a thin 3-px left-border accent bar in Philippine blue (#0038A8) to ONLY the section eyebrow span — implemented as a Tailwind inline style `style={{ borderLeftColor: '#0038A8' }}` and class `border-l-[3px] pl-2` to tastefully hint the Philippine palette without overriding tokens.

Step 3 — Create a new 'For Coaches' section component as CoachesSection inside app/page.tsx. Insert it AFTER PerformersSection and BEFORE the CTA section. Same pattern: id='coaches', g-section-alt class (alternating band), g-container, <SectionHeader>, <Reveal className='g-reveal-stagger'>, .g-card .g-card-hover cards. Only advertise CONFIRMED coach features found in app/(coach)/coach/home/page.tsx and coach QuickActions: (a) Showcase Feed — browse performer talent posts and find students (/coach/talents); (b) Manage Appointments — review and manage booked sessions (/coach/appointments); (c) Session Calendar — track your teaching schedule (/coach/calendar); (d) Messages — communicate with performers directly (/messages); (e) Studio Locator — find nearby rehearsal spaces (scroll to #studios); (f) Support Tickets — submit issues to the admin team (modal, already on coach dashboard). CTA button: 'Join as Coach' → links to /register/coach. Use icons: Sparkles, CalendarDays, Calendar, MessageSquare, MapPin, HelpCircle (already imported or importable). Grid: 2 cols sm, 3 lg. Add the same 3-px Philippine red (#CE1126) left-border accent on the section eyebrow.

Step 4 — Update the DEFAULT_PUBLIC_LINKS in components/shared/PublicLayout.tsx to add the two new sections to the public navbar. Append: { label: 'Performers', href: '/#performers' } and { label: 'Coaches', href: '/#coaches' } BEFORE the existing 'About' entry. Also add the new IDs to the sectionIds array in the IntersectionObserver inside PublicNavbar (add 'performers' and 'coaches'). This ensures active-link highlighting works for the new sections.

Step 5 — Verify all Lucide icon imports needed for PerformersSection and CoachesSection are present in app/page.tsx. The file already imports: Bot, MessageSquare, MapPin, Sparkles, ArrowRight. Add any missing: Calendar, CalendarDays, HelpCircle (check existing import list first — Calendar and CalendarDays are NOT in the current import block). Add them to the existing import { ... } from 'lucide-react' line.
acceptance_criteria: The CTA section visually shows subtle Filipino sun-ray and star SVG motifs without obscuring text or buttons
A 'For Performers' section appears between the Features section and the CTA, with 6 feature cards linking to real routes
A 'For Coaches' section appears between 'For Performers' and the CTA, with 6 feature cards linking to real routes
Both new sections use Reveal for scroll animation with the existing stagger pattern
Both new sections use SectionHeader and match the existing dark theme token system
The navbar links include 'Performers' and 'Coaches' entries with active-link highlighting
No existing section (Hero, Disciplines, Stats, Studios, How It Works, Features, CTA) is removed or reordered
Logo usage is unchanged — it already appears correctly in navbar (PublicNavbar) and Footer
verification: npm run lint — must exit 0 with no new errors
npm run build — must complete successfully with no TypeScript errors
findings: SectionHeader.eyebrow prop is typed string (not ReactNode), so the Philippine accent-bar eyebrow was implemented as a sibling <div> rendered just above <SectionHeader> in each new section, passing only title+subtext to SectionHeader. The custom eyebrow span uses g-eyebrow class + border-l-[3px] + inline style borderLeftColor. SVG in CTA uses Array.from().map() for sun rays which is valid React/TSX. All 47 pre-existing lint errors are in other files — neither app/page.tsx nor components/shared/PublicLayout.tsx produced any new errors. npm run lint exits 0 on both modified files. npm run build exits 0 cleanly.
